# Results

Do not type estimates by hand.
When an approved result file exists, load it in the setup chunk with `require_approved(read_result("….json"))` and build the table or figure from that object.
Number and title are the captions below (`tbl-cap` / `fig-cap`). Do not draw them on the PNG.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-example
#| tbl-cap: "Replace this example once an approved result file exists."
#| eval: false

# obj <- require_approved(read_result("OUT-001.json"), "OUT-001")
# flextable::flextable(as.data.frame(obj$table)) |> style_flextable()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-example
#| fig-cap: "Replace with a figure written from an approved result."
#| eval: false

# knitr::include_graphics(figure_path("fig-example.png"))
```
